project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend for IoT energy monitoring system
test_framework: Vitest 5.0.0 (no tests exist for monitoring pages yet, testing is manual)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' from frontend/ directory — must succeed with zero TypeScript errors. 2. Start dev server with 'npm run dev', navigate to /dashboard and /analytics as public (not logged in) and as admin (logged in as SYSTEM_ADMIN), verify all visual changes are present. 3. Click theme toggle (sun/moon icon), verify colors update. 4. Resize browser to mobile, tablet, desktop breakpoints, verify responsive layouts. 5. Use keyboard only (Tab, Enter) to navigate, verify focus ring is visible. 6. Open DevTools Network tab, throttle to Offline, verify status pill shows 'Offline' and KPIs show '--'. 7. Hard-refresh page, verify skeleton loading appears then real data renders.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Build output goes to frontend/dist/ but is not checked in.
environment_constraints: Do NOT change any data fetching logic (hooks, API calls, WebSocket), routing, authentication, or role-based access control. This is a visual redesign only. Do NOT add new npm dependencies (except possibly a font loader if absolutely needed). Work in the frontend/ directory only, do not touch backend code.
contribution_requirements: Build must succeed with zero TypeScript errors. No console errors in dev server. All user flows (public and admin) must work. Theme toggle must work. Responsive layouts must work on mobile, tablet, desktop. Accessibility focus ring must be visible. No PublicUserBanner component renders anywhere after completion.
key_patterns: 1. Existing landing page uses Bricolage Grotesque font, --landing-* CSS variables (in landing.css), floating glass pill navigation with sliding highlight (useSlidingIndicator hook in frontend/src/features/landing/hooks/useSlidingIndicator.ts, LandingNav component in frontend/src/features/landing/components/LandingNav.tsx), 28-32px border-radius, cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.15, 1) easing. 2. Current monitoring pages use Inter font, --color-* CSS variables (in index.css), heavy floating sidebar (DashboardLayout.tsx), 6-12px border-radius. 3. Role detection: getUserRole(isAuthenticated, user) returns 'public' or 'admin'. Public users are unauthenticated, admin users are SYSTEM_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. 4. Theme toggle: useTheme() hook from ThemeContext.tsx provides theme ('light' or 'dark') and toggleTheme() function. 5. Data hooks: useDashboardMetrics, useSystemHealth, useLiveSensorData (in frontend/src/features/dashboard/hooks/), useAnalyticsData and similar (in frontend/src/features/analytics/hooks/). 6. Charts use Recharts v3.9. Icons use Lucide React v1.25.
directory_structure: frontend/src/: features/ (landing, dashboard, analytics, auth), components/ (common, dashboard, layout), layouts/ (DashboardLayout.tsx), contexts/ (ThemeContext.tsx, AuthContext.tsx), hooks/, lib/ (permissions.ts, theme.ts), styles/ (index.css, landing.css, design-tokens.ts), routes/ (routes.config.ts), api/ (services/). Build config in frontend/ root: package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json.
